# Data

> Player save data (ProfileService): Get / Set / Save, session locking, auto-save.

- Package: `Data` · Category: Data & players
- Starts at server boot: **yes, whenever installed** (it has work to do before its first call)
- Installing it also installs: [Migration](Migration.md), [Util](Util.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Data")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Data")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Data`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/DataManager/init.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Data = GaxiaServer.Data
```

### Functions

- `Data.Get(player: Player, key: string?): any`
  Returns Profile.Data[key] when key is given, or the whole data table otherwise.
- `Data.Set(player: Player, key: string, value: any): boolean`
  Writes a key to Profile.Data and fires OnDataChanged. Returns false if profile is not loaded.
- `Data.WaitFor(player: Player, timeout: number?): any`
  Yields until profile loaded; returns the Data table or nil on timeout / leave.
- `Data.IsLoaded(player: Player): boolean`
- `Data.Save(player: Player): ()`
  Force-save (ProfileService persists periodically, this just nudges it).

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Data.OnLoaded` — `Signal<Player, PlayerData>`
  ── Signals ── (player, data) once the player's profile is loaded, reconciled and migrated
- `Data.OnReleased` — `Signal<Player>`
  (player) after the player's profile is released (leave or shutdown)
- `Data.OnDataChanged` — `Signal<Player, string, any>`
  (player, key, value) after DataManager.Set

### Fields

- `Data.DEFAULT_PROFILE = { … } (multi-line: see the source)`
  Default profile schema: anything missing in saved data is filled via Reconcile.

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type PlayerData = {
    Coins: number,
    Gems: number,
    Level: number,
    Experience: number,
    Inventory: { [string]: number },
    Settings: { Music: boolean, SFX: boolean },
    PlayTime: number,
    LastLogin: number,
    -- Schema version read/written by DataMigration.Migrate (key: __version).
    -- Baseline = 1: the current DEFAULT_PROFILE shape IS schema v1. Existing
    -- unlabeled saves are normalised to v1 by Reconcile (their shape already
    -- matches); future schema changes bump to v2+ and register N→N+1 migrations.
    __version: number,
}
```
